reviews.text:
We would give Mark at Hourman LLC 100 Gold Stars, if that was an option. Attention to detail, quality workmanship & product use, great/consistent communication, reliable (in word and deed), fair & transparent pricing, professional and very knowledgeable about the processes which produce lasting quality work.  Mark and his team did a remarkable job of refreshing & repairing our “tired” fence, transforming our tool shed, clearing out our clogged gutters, and properly diagnosing & repairing two leaking patio sky lights (they even checked the 3rd sky light to make sure it was properly sealed and not about to fail) - ALL this work in FOUR days! (Mark put in lots of prep work to make everything go smoothly and quickly once they started the job on the property). We would definitely recommend Mark at Hourman, LLC to anyone needing home repair and we plan on using him for all of our home repair needs.  Thank you, Mark, for all of your hard work and refreshing our backyard space so beautifully!
* Note: I included 2 photos of our OLD fence - You can clearly see how he & his team totally transformed it in the first photos!
reviews.author: Candace Snyder

reviews.text:
I recently had my fence installed by Mark, and the quality of the work was excellent. He was professional throughout the entire process and clearly takes pride in what he does. The craftsmanship and attention to detail really show—my new fence looks fantastic and feels built to last.

He was also great at communicating, taking the time to walk me through my options and make sure I was comfortable with every step. I appreciated how everything went from start to finish. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a well-installed, great-looking fence.
reviews.author: Ryan I

reviews.text: Mark at Hourman was fantastic! He was very quick to come and give a quote to repair my fence. Not only was his quote reasonable but also better than any others I got. He preformed the work quickly and was great on communication. I would highly recommend Mark/Hourman to anyone needing a new fence or a fence repair. My fence looks great and I couldn’t be happier!
reviews.author: Andrew Webb

reviews.text: I have high praises for Mark Whitaker and his crew. They were professional, highly skilled, generous,  kind, and sensitive to our particular needs.. They built a beautiful wood fence for our property and went beyond our requests and expectations. I am very glad that we chose them. Without any hesitation I recommend Hourman LLC for your fencing needs.
reviews.author: Kathleen Meyer

reviews.text: We hired Mark to do our fence after the old one started looking .... well .... old and battered. We found his price reasonable and his service was above par.  He kept us informed every step of the way and ensured the job was done in a timely manner.  We were so pleased that we have recommended him to several co-workers and friends, who have also had work done by him.
reviews.author: Ghost

reviews.text: We contracted Mark in late June '24 after the Memorial Day storm to tear down our original 1984 fence and replace it.  Within a few weeks, Mark designed and built a wonderful fence that is sure to be the last fence we will ever need.  His communication throughout the process was excellent and he was always honest and transparent.  When we wanted to include additional work to remove some troublesome trees and roots, he was very fair with his pricing.  The fence is absolutely beautiful and he went the extra mile to ensure it's durability.  We are very pleased with his work and professionalism and highly recommend.
reviews.author: daynonf

reviews.text: We hired Mark for several projects and call him when an experienced professional is needed. He’s considerate and keeps his appointments. He is honest and full of integrity. He keeps in touch regarding the projects and provides updates as needed. Mark is very experienced in many areas. He’s a great person. We recommend Hourman LLC highly.
reviews.author: Rebecca Partain

reviews.text: We initially hired Mark at Hourman for exterior painting, and he exceeded all expectations! His attention to detail was incredible. He communicated every step of the way, keeping us updated on progress and timelines. We were so impressed that we brought him back for several other projects and his work was consistently top-notch. He’s thorough, honest, and clearly takes pride in what he does. Finding someone this reliable and skilled is rare—highly recommend!
reviews.author: Elysa Burgess
